notes: Web 394 — APP-STORAGE-WALL-NOV9 (owner evidence, Nov 9, 2026, four surfaces, one wall: the Documents filing of the Nov 5 CVSA report refused TWICE on the web client ('storage may be full — nothing was saved'); both fuel receipt photos of the day previewed then dropped on save ('didn't fit in this device's app storage'); the photo-based dispatch close failed TWICE with the storage-write error while the typed close landed; and on the PHONE that evening his signed post-trip PTI refused to save ('the app storage on your phone looks full') — beside a Device Care screenshot showing 137.3 GB / 256 GB used, ~118 GB FREE. The device was never the wall.) CONVICTED by tools/app-storage-wall-v394-test.js (failing-first on shipped 393: at a Nov-9-shaped origin calibrated to the v372 finding — 5,241,390 chars, 2,980 bytes of headroom under the Chromium accounting — the REAL PTI verified save, the REAL Documents addDoc and a small growing write are all refused; 11 passed / 9 failed there, 27/27 here): every book persists as ONE JSON string in the origin's localStorage with photos inline as base64 data URLs, and Chromium caps the whole origin's localStorage at 10 MiB counted in UTF-16 bytes. The accumulated inline photo cache (the fuel book foremost — the graft tops it up whenever a photo fits — plus damage/dispatch photos, PTI signatures, live-miles crumb trails) fills the pool to within a few KB, and from then on every save that must GROW the store throws QuotaExceededError in every module, while non-growing writes keep landing — the typed close, the figures — exactly the field pattern on both the WebView and the desktop profile. THE FIX (storage layer only; no layout, no widget, no counting/timer changes; Job A hunks NOT in this release): (1) js/app.js — the store gains a RELIEF REGISTRY: when a write dies on the ceiling, registered shedders free room and the write retries; a handler that owns the failing key is skipped for it (Fuel's book writes keep their own ladder+reclaim economy, undisturbed), and when nothing frees enough the store fires the handler's one-shot ARM for the NEXT failure. The store also gains usageChars(). (2) modules/fuel.js — THE SAFE SET + SHEDDER + AUDIT: a photo earns a safe mark (store key fuel_photo_safe) ONLY when its full stack is confirmed in its per-record account document — a save handler's landed write (marks attach no rejection handler, so rejected writes stay exactly as unhandled as the v372 round pinned), the reclaim's awaited write, or the AUDIT. The shedder drops this device's copies of MARKED photos only, largest first, a margin past the ask — facts never move, unmarked photos are never shed (their only full copy may be local), and the graft heals copies back when there is room. The audit is the relief ARM: it writes every unmarked photo's full stack to its account document, awaited, marking only on success — so the standing book becomes sheddable without a single shed on a guess, and the driver's retry of a refused save (the PTI form keeps his inspection) finds marks to shed. NO graft ceiling: an earlier draft capped the graft at a reserve and the round-4 spent book convicted it (the graft legitimately lands photos into reclaim-freed room) — v373 stands 32/32 with it removed. (3) modules/documents.js — THE ACCOUNT COPY + LADDER: every save first writes the FULL record to its own account document (users/<uid>/documents/<id>; the rules' owner wildcard already covers it), so a document's bytes no longer live only in the local store the sync copy sheds; the form builds once (one id), writes the account copy with the full page, then saves locally, retrying down the house fit ladder (960px, 640px) before reporting failure — the full page is in the account either way.
